text:
julia: Heads-up — a customer hit a production loop in the node sample that replays identical pages after an auth refresh. Seeing repeated cursor values and 429 spikes.

sam: Oof. Node or sampleapp? quick logs please.

julia: sample logs: `2025-02-10T15:40:10Z INFO auth: rotating token`, `15:40:10Z INFO lease: release id=7 because auth-change`, `15:40:10Z INFO paginator: next_cursor=cur_42`, `15:40:10Z WARN fetch: 429 for cur_42`, `15:40:11Z ERROR worker: duplicate page cur_42`

kevin: Sounds like the SDK releases leases immediately on token swap, which lets multiple workers claim same cursor concurrently. Node SDK and python SDK parity gap? we changed python earlier but maybe not node.

sam: We did adjust python to stall releases, but node still releases immediately. I thought we added a common core lib — looks like node kept older behavior.

julia: Customer had lease_ttl=1s and token rotate ~200ms. low ttl + immediate release = burst reclaim.

kevin: Two paths: (A) change node SDK to match python (stall window with jitter) or (B) make a cross-SDK core primitive (lease_manager.stall_on_auth_change) and roll out everywhere.

sam: Preference B for long-term parity, but that's bigger. Quick patch would be to add env var REDWOOD_LEASE_AUTH_STALL in node too.

julia: Also recommend sampleapp persist the last-ack cursor in sqlite with CAS so two processes don't race.

kevin: Can we add an idempotency header on page fetches like `X-RW-Page-Id: sha1(cursor|session)` so server dedupes? Might require server change but would be robust.

sam: I'll open a small PR for node that mirrors python's stall behavior and expose a toggle env var. Tests: unit for lease-stall timing + integration sim with token rotate.

julia: I'll patch the sampleapp to use a tiny sqlite store and CAS update for next_cursor. Add an optional flag `--lease-stall=true` for quick rollout.

docs-bot: note added: doc-issue 462: "Auth rotation + leases: best practices".

kevin: Alerts: infra please add a metric `page.duplicate.count` and a dashboard for token-rotation vs lease-releases. If duplicate_count > 3/min for a customer, DM them.

sam: deploy-bot: queueing branch=fix/node-lease-stall, reviewers=@kevin,@julia. CI will run sim.

docs-bot: Also created a short onboarding blurb: "If using short lease_ttl (<3s) and token refresh, persist cursor and enable lease stall".

julia: Another note — we should avoid changing defaults right away. Make the stall opt-in for one minor release, then consider opt-out with telemetry.

kevin: Agreed. Action items: sam -> node SDK PR; julia -> sampleapp sqlite CAS + flag; infra -> metrics+alert; docs -> onboarding blurb. I'll track PRs.

sam: starting PR now. will ping when CI green.

julia: thanks. tagging this thread with #sdk-parity #leases #pagination.
